// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/services/blueprints: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const BLUEPRINTS_PROVIDER_ID = "system.blueprints";

export type BlueprintAdoptedTarget = {
    kind: "personal";
} | {
    kind: "project";
    project_id: string;
};

export interface BlueprintAdoptionApplyInput {
    preview_id: string;
    part_ids: string[];
    request_id: string;
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionApplyResult extends BlueprintAdoptionIdentity {
    steps: BlueprintApplyStep[];
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionPreviewInput<Proposal = BlueprintProposal> {
    source: BlueprintSource;
    target: BlueprintAdoptionTarget;
    part_ids: string[];
    changes?: BlueprintPreviewChange<Proposal>[];
    upgrade_of?: string;
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionPreviewResult {
    preview_id: string;
    expires_at: string;
    source: BlueprintSource;
    target: BlueprintAdoptionTarget;
    locale: string;
    parts: BlueprintPreviewPart[];
    upgrade?: BlueprintUpgradeComparison;
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionReadInput {
    adoption_id: string;
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionReadResult extends BlueprintAdoptionIdentity {
    apply_steps: BlueprintApplyStep[];
    latest_undo: UndoResult | null;
}

export type BlueprintAdoptionTarget = {
    kind: "personal" | "current_project";
} | {
    kind: "new_project";
    display_name: string;
};

export interface BlueprintAdoptionUndoInput extends BlueprintAdoptionReadInput {
    request_id: string;
}

export interface BlueprintAdoptionUndoResult<Operation extends UndoOperation = UndoOperation> {
    adoption_id: string;
    undo: UndoResult<Operation>;
}

export type BlueprintApplyStep = {
    part_id: string;
} & ({
    state: "not_started";
} | {
    state: "needs_install";
    preview_id: string;
} | {
    state: "applied";
    outcome: AdoptionOutcome;
    receipt: BlueprintOwnerReceipt;
    approval?: BlueprintApprovalStep;
    current?: (typeof appliedCurrentStates)[number];
} | {
    state: "applied";
    outcome: "reused";
    current?: (typeof appliedCurrentStates)[number];
} | InterruptedStep);

export type BlueprintCurrentValue = {
    state: "present";
    value: SandboxJson;
    origin: BlueprintPartOrigin | null;
    revision?: AdoptionRevision;
} | {
    state: "missing";
} | {
    state: "unavailable";
    reason: string;
};

export interface BlueprintDraftReadInput {
    draft_id: string;
}

export interface BlueprintDraftResult {
    draft: {
        source: DraftSource;
        blueprint: Blueprint;
        locale: string;
    };
}

export type BlueprintDraftSaveInput<Body = Blueprint> = {
    blueprint: Body;
} & ({
    expected_revision: null;
} | {
    draft_id: string;
    expected_revision: number;
});

export interface BlueprintOwnerReceipt {
    action: ExactActionReference;
    subject: ActionSubject;
    revision: AdoptionRevision;
}

export interface BlueprintPackSaveInput {
    source: DraftSource | {
        kind: "adoption";
        adoption_id: string;
    };
}

export interface BlueprintPackSaveResult {
    preview_id: string;
}

export type BlueprintPreviewCandidate = {
    kind: "owner";
    action: ExactActionReference;
    subject?: ActionSubject;
    current: BlueprintCurrentValue;
} | {
    kind: "bundled";
    plugin_id: string;
    version: string;
};

export interface BlueprintPreviewChange<Proposal = BlueprintProposal> {
    part_id: string;
    proposal?: Proposal;
    selection?: BlueprintPreviewSelection;
    action?: ExactActionReference;
}

export interface BlueprintPreviewPart {
    part_id: string;
    proposal: BlueprintProposal;
    layer: SettingLayer;
    candidates: BlueprintPreviewCandidate[];
    decision: (typeof decisions)[number];
    consequences: SettingConsequence[];
    affected_step_ids: string[];
}

export type BlueprintPreviewSelection = {
    kind: "create";
} | {
    kind: "reuse" | "update";
    subject: ActionSubject;
};

export interface BlueprintUpgradeComparison {
    adoption_id: string;
    locale: string;
    parts: BlueprintUpgradePart[];
}

export type BlueprintUpgradePart = {
    part_id: string;
    current: BlueprintCurrentValue;
    keep_user_changes: boolean;
    dependency_changes: Array<{
        part_id: string;
        change: (typeof dependencyChanges)[number];
    }>;
} & ({
    before: BlueprintProposal;
    after: BlueprintProposal | null;
} | {
    before: null;
    after: BlueprintProposal;
});

export interface UndoResult<Operation extends UndoOperation = UndoOperation> {
    operation: Operation;
    request_id: string;
    steps: UndoStep[];
}

export type UndoStep = {
    part_id: string;
} & ({
    state: "restored";
    receipt: BlueprintOwnerReceipt;
} | {
    state: "detached";
    receipt?: BlueprintOwnerReceipt;
} | InterruptedStep);

export declare const blueprintActions: {
    draftSave: ActionDefinition<BlueprintDraftSaveInput, BlueprintDraftResult>;
    draftRead: ActionDefinition<BlueprintDraftReadInput, BlueprintDraftResult>;
    preview: ActionDefinition<BlueprintAdoptionPreviewInput, BlueprintAdoptionPreviewResult>;
    apply: ActionDefinition<BlueprintAdoptionApplyInput, BlueprintAdoptionApplyResult>;
    read: ActionDefinition<BlueprintAdoptionReadInput, BlueprintAdoptionReadResult>;
    revert: ActionDefinition<BlueprintAdoptionUndoInput, BlueprintAdoptionUndoResult<"revert">>;
    remove: ActionDefinition<BlueprintAdoptionUndoInput, BlueprintAdoptionUndoResult<"remove">>;
    packSave: ActionDefinition<BlueprintPackSaveInput, BlueprintPackSaveResult>;
};

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface BlueprintAdoptionIdentity {
    adoption_id: string;
    source: BlueprintSource;
    target: BlueprintAdoptedTarget;
    locale: string;
}

type BlueprintApprovalStep = {
    page_id: string;
    version: number;
    approval_request_id: string;
};

type BlueprintStepError = {
    code: string;
    message: string;
};

type DraftSource = Extract<BlueprintSource, {
    kind: "draft";
}>;

type InterruptedStep = ({
    state: "needs_approval";
} & BlueprintApprovalStep) | {
    state: "failed";
    error: BlueprintStepError;
} | {
    state: "pending_verification";
    request_id: string;
} | {
    state: "skipped";
    reason: (typeof skipReasons)[number];
};

type UndoOperation = "revert" | "remove";

declare const appliedCurrentStates: readonly ["changed", "owner_unavailable"];

declare const decisions: readonly ["create", "reuse", "update", "needs_choice", "needs_install", "skip"];

declare const dependencyChanges: readonly ["added", "removed", "changed"];

declare const skipReasons: readonly ["not_selected", "dependency_unmet", "unsupported", "scope_mismatch", "owner_unavailable", "revision_changed", "reused", "shared", "no_revert"];
